article.title: A statement in response to Andreas Malm being denied entry into the United Kingdom
article.author: Tariq Ali
article.content: Verso author Andreas Malm has been denied permission to enter the UK ahead of the Historical Materialism Conference. Tariq Ali issued this statement. The post A statement in response to Andreas Malm being denied entry into the United Kingdom appeared first on MR Online .
